title: Count down
prompt: Return an array counting down from n to 1, like [3, 2, 1]. For 0, return an empty array. Use a while loop.
hint: Keep a counter `i` starting at n. `while i > 0:` append i to the array, then `i -= 1`.
solution:
func solve(n: int) -> Array:
	var result = []
	var i = n
	while i > 0:
		result.append(i)
		i -= 1
	return result
